added_failures_note: Derived from the reviewed run's own gate logs census/suite-arm-base.log at 6acc2ef37f3ff08cb61c34802f2efb7f13445bcb ('26 failed, 367 passed', EXIT=1) and census/suite-arm-head.log at bd7f02bc7b506b1de21e0d8eb0dc25e144fd68f3 ('26 failed, 367 passed', EXIT=1); the two sorted FAILED id lists are set-equal under comm -13 and comm -23, so the head arm adds no failure the base arm did not already fail.

findings.text: blocking: The delivered manifest is a seven-line stub whose status was written by the coordinator's repair rather than by the worker: it carries commits and a one-line checkpoint but no tests, test_logs, baseline_suite, after_suite, landing or rubric line, so nothing in the record ties commits 4a61e4e0af..bd7f02bc7b to the 3-passed gate, the 26-failed/367-passed arms or the red negative control, and a promotion reading it cannot reconcile it against the logs it would cite.

blocking: The done_when's census clause has no head measurement: the base arm completed six ticks (census/decode-census-base.log decode_bytes_total 127.1, 160.7, 162.6, 208.8, 142.9 and 154.6 MB), while the head arm stops after tick 1 with EXIT=135 and census/slurm-1319121.out:1 records a Bus error for that run, so the 'at most a tenth of base's bytes per tick after the first tick' comparison cannot be made; the harness used is also a new census/decode_census.py rather than the station memory census the done_when names.

non-blocking: The summary builds a second identity-keyed stream cache beside _cached_stream_entry at reckon/_backends.py:3640, duplicating the identity tuple, the head-fingerprint growth test and the bounded eviction loop with its own limit (_STREAM_SUMMARY_LIMIT, 2048 entries) and its own lock, so the two caches can drift on what counts as growth and only the parse primitives are shared.

baseline_suite.failure_ids_note: the same 26 ids the head arm fails; the lists are set-equal

negative_control.summary: 3 failed; the three tests redden at 200040, 200050 and 196039 decodes

item_verdicts.diff: Read 4a61e4e0af, 232f9e1191, 5c5916a4d0 and bd7f02bc7b against 6acc2ef3 commit by commit: 345 added lines in reckon/_backends.py and a new 219-line tests/test_a_stream_is_decoded_once_per_byte.py, two files changed and no others.
item_verdicts.done_when: Read every clause against the test file and the run's logs: tests/test_a_stream_is_decoded_once_per_byte.py:167 asserts the second pass makes 0 decodes, :189 asserts ten appended records are exactly 10 decodes, :213 asserts a truncated stream is read whole, gate-head-bd7f02bc7b506b1de21e0d8eb0dc25e144fd68f3.log records 3 passed EXIT=0, and negative-control-bd7f02bc7b506b1de21e0d8eb0dc25e144fd68f3.log records 3 failed EXIT=1 under the stated mutation; the census clause has no head arm, because census/decode-census-head.log:1552 ends at tick 1 with EXIT=135 while the base arm ran six.
item_verdicts.goal: Read the goal in dispatch-detail.json node.goal and section s69 of docs/plans/the-monitor-reads-each-fact-once.html; reckon/_backends.py:3867 answers an unchanged stream from the identity it was last read at without touching a byte, and :3871 reads a grown stream only from stored.offset, so the tick's three stream readers decode only the bytes a stream gained.
item_verdicts.manifest: Read manifest.md: seven lines at status complete carrying commits and a one-line checkpoint, with no tests, test_logs, baseline_suite, after_suite, landing or rubric line; manifest.md.asdelivered differs only at line 5, and status-repair.json records that the host died and the coordinator set complete itself.
item_verdicts.write_paths: Read prompt.txt and dispatch-detail.json node.write_paths (five declared paths); the diff touches reckon/_backends.py and tests/test_a_stream_is_decoded_once_per_byte.py, both declared, and none of the other three, so nothing lands outside the fence.

justifications.durability: tests/test_a_stream_is_decoded_once_per_byte.py:167 reddens at 200040 when the summary is disabled and :189 and :213 redden at 200050 and 196039, so each clause of the gate has a recorded code change that puts it back red.
justifications.evidence: gate-head-bd7f02bc7b506b1de21e0d8eb0dc25e144fd68f3.log records 3 passed EXIT=0 and the matched arms are set-equal at 26 failed and 367 passed, but census/decode-census-head.log:1552 stops after one tick at EXIT=135 and manifest.md:5 records no result at all.
justifications.fit: the addition is a private dataclass pair at reckon/_backends.py:3739 with the module's own RLock and docstring idiom, and its 'summarised' spelling matches reckon/hooks/coordinator_obligations.py:834.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/_backends.py:3867 returns the stored summary for a matching identity with no read and :3871 seeks to stored.offset for a grown file, so every reader whose answers the summary holds decodes only the bytes gained.
justifications.reuse: reckon/_backends.py:3844 forks the identity tuple, head-fingerprint growth test and bounded eviction of _cached_stream_entry at :3640 into a second cache, though it reuses parse_events, _stream_lines_from, stream_head_fingerprint and _cached_stream_entry itself and publishes into the events cache through _publish_summary_records.
justifications.scope_discipline: the diff is confined to reckon/_backends.py and tests/test_a_stream_is_decoded_once_per_byte.py, both inside the five declared write paths, and adds nothing the goal does not imply.
